search_window.basis: Previous latest completed Food Line heartbeat independently verified on ops/watch-ledger at search start. Qualifying new notices/events must fall after that checkpoint, not merely appear in recently crawled historical pages.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value Food Line miss-class recall only; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Only, sole, last or full-service grocery loss/closure/fire/disaster
Canceled/suspended emergency food distribution from storm, flood, fire, outage or damaged facility
Abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service/access reduction
New official SNAP, WIC or food-assistance interruption immediately limiting access

coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Ignored donation drives, food-resource guides, opinion, routine promotions, older closures, general economic pressure, prior watch duplicates and page crawl dates not establishing new incidents.
coverage_notes.assessment: No qualifying new event or official notice verified in the short hourly observation window. Search indexing lag and publication-date ambiguity mean this supplementary check is not proof of nationwide absence.
